metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1976 · The Outlaw Josey Wales
metas.description: Missouri farmer Josey Wales joins a Confederate guerrilla unit and winds up on the run from the Union soldiers who murdered his family.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1974 · Blazing Saddles
metas.description: In order to ruin a western town and steal their land, a corrupt politician appoints a black sheriff, who promptly becomes his most formidable adversary.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1972 · Jeremiah Johnson
metas.description: A mountain man who wishes to live the life of a hermit becomes the unwilling object of a long vendetta by the Crow tribe and proves to be a match for their warriors in single combat on the early frontier.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1971 · McCabe & Mrs. Miller
metas.description: A gambler and a prostitute become business partners in a remote Old West mining town, and their enterprise thrives until a large corporation arrives on the scene.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1976 · The Shootist
metas.description: A dying gunfighter spends his last days looking for a way to die with a minimum of pain and a maximum of dignity.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1971 · Duck, You Sucker!
metas.description: A low-life bandit and an I.R.A. explosives expert rebel against the government and become heroes of the Mexican Revolution.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1970 · Little Big Man
metas.description: Jack Crabb, looking back from extreme old age, tells of his life being raised by Native Americans and fighting with General Custer.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1973 · High Plains Drifter
metas.description: A stranger makes townsfolk prepare garish welcome for convicts.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1970 · They Call Me Trinity
metas.description: A lazy, unorthodox gunfighter and his portly, horse-thieving brother defend a Mormon settlement from a land-grabbing Major, a Mexican bandit, and their henchmen.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1973 · My Name Is Nobody
metas.description: A young, easy-going gunman worships and competes with a famed gunfighter, insisting that he must face down a gang of 150 outlaws before he can retire.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1970 · El Topo
metas.description: A mysterious black-clad gunfighter wanders a mystical Western landscape encountering multiple bizarre characters.
